title: Coffee remains a daily household routine while specialty, app, drive-through, and out-of-home formats diversify the consumption occasion
source_unit: National Coffee Association, 2026 National Coffee Data Trends Fall Report media highlights, conducted by Dig Insights
geography: United States adult coffee and beverage consumption, June 2026 field period

denominator.unit: U.S. adults in the NCDT survey universe

past_day_coffee.unit: share of American adults drinking coffee in the past day

at_home_preparation.unit: share of past-day coffee drinkers having coffee at home

out_of_home_recovery.unit: share of past-day coffee drinkers consuming coffee out of home

observations.method: NCA media highlights from the twice-yearly National Coffee Data Trends study, conducted by Dig Insights; the NCA reports a nationally representative sample of 1,882 adults aged 18 and over.
observations.uncertainty: This is a trade-association release summarizing a commissioned survey; it is not a transaction dataset, longitudinal behavior record, causal estimate, or independent assessment of the coffee market.
observations.subgroup: U.S. adults and coffee drinkers, with household and out-of-home consumption occasions represented in the reported measures.
observations.counterinterpretation: Stable daily use may reflect habit and routine rather than growing cultural attachment, while the out-of-home rebound may reflect channel substitution or seasonal conditions rather than durable social reconnection.

denominator.unit: U.S. adults in the reported NCDT measures

specialty_coffee.unit: share of American adults drinking specialty coffee in the past day

specialty_vs_traditional.value: specialty coffee exceeded traditional coffee in the reported past-day measure

espresso_beverage.unit: share of American adults having an espresso-based beverage in the past week

espresso_change.unit: change in the reported espresso-based beverage measure since 2022

observations.method: Descriptive comparison of NCDT beverage categories and the NCA’s historical comparison for espresso-based drinks.
observations.uncertainty: Category definitions, field timing, recall, seasonality, and the trade-association sponsorship limit interpretation as a broad cultural transformation or durable demand forecast.
observations.subgroup: Adults choosing specialty, espresso-based, traditional, hot, or cold coffee formats across home and out-of-home occasions.
observations.counterinterpretation: Specialty growth may represent product relabeling, price and menu changes, or substitution within a stable coffee routine rather than a wholly new consumption identity.

drive_through.unit: share of past-week out-of-home coffee buyers ordering at a drive-through

app_ordering.unit: share of past-week out-of-home coffee buyers ordering on an app

grocery_channel.unit: share of in-home coffee purchases attributed to grocery stores

mass_merchant_channel.unit: share of in-home coffee purchases attributed to mass merchandisers

observations.method: NCA descriptive channel summary comparing reported at-home and out-of-home purchase routes.
observations.uncertainty: These are reported channel shares rather than transaction-level data; they do not identify prices, margins, repeat frequency, retailer substitution, or whether app ordering changes loyalty or labor conditions.
observations.subgroup: Past-week out-of-home coffee buyers and consumers purchasing coffee for in-home preparation.
observations.counterinterpretation: Drive-through and app use can signal convenience and routine compression, but they may also reflect commuting patterns, accessibility, promotions, or limited alternatives rather than a generalized preference for frictionless consumption.

related_sources.claim: NCA’s National Coffee Data Trends landing page provides the recurring study context and report access.
NCA’s consumer-facing background provides context on coffee categories and preparation occasions.

boundary: This record adds an everyday-consumption and consumer-channel signal linking routine, specialty differentiation, at-home and out-of-home occasions, drive-through and app convenience, and retail-channel movement. It is a trade-association summary of a commissioned cross-sectional survey, not respondent-level ingestion, transaction data, a longitudinal trend estimate, a causal model, a measure of household affordability, or proof of durable cultural change.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The official NCA newsroom page was reviewed for the June 2026 field period, reported daily, at-home, out-of-home, specialty, espresso, channel, and sample-size measures; the NCA trade-association provenance and survey boundary were retained.
